# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made in the latest release. Please upgrade to it before
reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security issues in public issues or pull requests.
Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/VectorDB-NTU/RaBitQ-Library/security/advisories/new)
and include the affected version, platform, and steps or a file that reproduces
the problem.

We will acknowledge the report, keep you updated on the fix, and credit you in
the advisory unless you prefer otherwise.
